params.prompt: Standalone Flashpoint technology headquarters in Atlantis. Energetic 75 metre mid-rise within a compact 40 by 32 metre footprint. Sharp but believable asymmetrical silhouette with a sloping roofline and stepped upper floors, dark cool glass, refined silver structure and a few controlled warm orange accents. Strong compact street-facing podium with integrated blank launch panel, thin ticker and modest entrance sign facing south. Communicate rapid growth, product launches, ambition and market pressure. Architectural credibility, clean mobile-friendly mesh and strong silhouette. Single building only, no surrounding city, ground plane, roads, cars or trees. Avoid giant advertisements, casinos, stadiums, nightclubs, cyberpunk clutter, neon-covered facades, floating parts and fantasy geometry.
